load_model_k400: load a pretrained MViT model from Kinetics400 with feature extraction enabled
load_model_imagenet: load a pretrained MViT model from ImageNet with feature extraction enabled
load_model_no_patch: load a pretrained MViT model without patching the final classification layer
get_transform_k400: get a video transform pipeline for normalizing and cropping video frames for MViT
ModelConfig_custom: create a ModelConfig dataclass with custom side size, crop size, mean, and std values
